title: Iowa Administrative Code 441—40.21, 41.27, 41.28 (Family Investment Program)
deposited: Three whole rules: definitions (40.21, incl. 'payment standard' and 'standard of need'); income (41.27: 20% earned income deduction, 58% work incentive disregard, 185% gross income test, grant = payment standard minus countable net income); need standards (41.28: Schedule of Needs by household size - schedule of basic needs, the payment standard, $426 for 3 persons; schedule of living costs; 185% of living costs; chart of basic needs components).
converter: the Legislature's .rtf download (an Office Open XML .docx) to text with python-docx, tables as rows (scratchpad scripts iarules_deposit.py, mnrules_lib.py; not deposited)
official_status: unofficial plain-text conversion; the official edition is the chapter PDF
